<title level="2" right="Creature 12">[Endlo Kiver](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2550)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="CE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=54" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=91" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #190: The Choosing](/Sources.aspx?ID=198) pg. 52

**Perception** +22; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +25, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +21, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +21, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +22, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +22

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +5

**Dex** +1

**Con** +3

**Int** +0

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Items**
steel-colored [_bird feather token_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=244), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24)_, _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [half plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12)_, [_The Publican_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2486), [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of [Gorum](/Deities.aspx?ID=7)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 33 

**Fort** +22 

**Ref** +18 

**Will** +23 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 215

</row>

**Resistances**
slashing 3

**Juggernaut** When Endlo rolls a success at a Fortitude save, he gets a critical success instead.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_greatsword_ +26 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 3d12+11 slashing

**Divine Spontaneous Spells** DC 30, attack +22
- **Cantrips (6th)**
[Chill Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=35), [Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286), [Stabilize](/Spells.aspx?ID=307)
- **1st**
[Command](/Spells.aspx?ID=45), [Ray of Enfeeblement](/Spells.aspx?ID=244), [True Strike](/Spells.aspx?ID=345) (3 slots)
- **2nd**
[Death Knell](/Spells.aspx?ID=63), [Resist Energy](/Spells.aspx?ID=256), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) (3 slots)
- **3rd**
[Chilling Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=36), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146), [Remove Disease](/Spells.aspx?ID=251) (3 slots)
- **4th**
[Air Walk](/Spells.aspx?ID=6), [Dimensional Anchor](/Spells.aspx?ID=70), [Enlarge](/Spells.aspx?ID=102) (3 slots)
- **5th**
[Flame Strike](/Spells.aspx?ID=120), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) (3 slots)
- **6th**
[Heroism](/Spells.aspx?ID=149), [Weapon Storm](/Spells.aspx?ID=373), [Zealous Conviction](/Spells.aspx?ID=378) (3 slots)

**Gorum's Hand**   Endlo deals an additional die of damage with greatswords (included in his Strike above), which also adds an additional die to his [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=373) spell.

**Replenishment of War**   When Endlo damages a creature with a greatsword Strike, he gains 6 temporary Hit Points until the start of his next turn. If the Strike was a critical hit, he instead gains 12 temporary Hit Points.

**Resolute Stance** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Stance](/Traits.aspx?ID=152)) Endlo draws upon the might of stone to bolster his defenses. While in this stance, he gains a +2 status bonus to his AC and increases his resistance to slashing damage to 15, but he reduces his Speeds by 5 feet.

</column>
name: Endlo Kiver
